full_name: Jane Rhodes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Humanities Joy Foundation Fellow Macalester College
bio: Jane Rhodes is the dean for the study of race and ethnicity and a professor of American studies at Macalester College. Her scholarship has focused on African American freedom struggles in the 19th and 20th centuries, the role of media and culture in social movements, and the politics of gender in African American communities.
